source.snippet: We're a YC backed healthtech product with a significant amount of need for safe manual data entry and updates, and the requirements for our admin dashboard are complex enough that Django Admin would not cut it. I wish there was a tool like ReTool that was tied to our regular backend and ORM.

problem_statement: Developers at startups and scale-ups need an internal admin dashboard framework that integrates directly with their existing ORM/backend (not just via REST), supporting complex validation and permissions without requiring custom frontend work.
target_segment: Full-stack engineering teams at B2B SaaS and healthtech startups (5–200 engineers) needing internal tooling beyond Django Admin but without Retool's external-data-only model
notes: Two separate HN threads (items 38051437 and 38072673) independently express the same pain. Retool itself acknowledged the gap and was building a solution (beta stage at time of capture). Persistent demand signal spanning 2023–2026 window.
